sourcePolicy: Reference artifacts are compact, source-traceable derivatives of approved theory-core files. They may summarize but may not add mathematics or contradict the approved core.
rules: Reference files must derive from an approved core version.
Every summarized concept or formula must point to a core ID or core field.
Worked-case numbers must match the approved core exactly.
Reference files must remain compact and must not duplicate assessment blueprints or implementation code.
Reference files must not contain UI labels, CSS, animation, layout directives or runtime behavior.
A reference artifact may select high-value failure modes, but its traceability block must state what was selected.
Downstream slideshow and full-view content may use the reference artifact but may not override the core.
